description: This source file defines the Java interface 'PubSubConfig' which specifies configuration parameters for a publish-subscribe system, including methods for retrieving configuration values, static factory methods to create config instances, and an internal enum for known configuration keys with default values.

classes.name: PubSubConfig
classes.description: A Java interface defining configuration methods and nested enum for pub-sub system settings.

methods.name: getSeed
methods.description: Returns the seed value used for hash functions, crucial for the distributed pub-sub consistency.

methods.name: getHashFamilySize
methods.description: Returns the number of hash functions used for Bloom filters, affecting false positive rate.

methods.name: getRestartDelay
methods.description: Returns the duration to wait before restarting a crashed pub-sub actor.

methods.name: getUpdateInterval
methods.description: Returns how frequently the distributed data is updated.

methods.name: getForceUpdateProbability
methods.description: Returns the probability that an update is forced on each clock tick to recover from disassociation.

methods.name: of (Config config)
methods.description: Static factory method to create a 'PubSubConfig' instance from a Typesafe 'Config' object.

methods.name: of (ActorSystem actorSystem)
methods.description: Static factory method to create a 'PubSubConfig' instance based on the settings of an Akka 'ActorSystem'.
